items.prompt: White to move. Can the pawn on d7 promote on this move, by moving ahead or by capturing? Predict, then check.

claims.statement: The pawn can legally move from d7 to d8 and promote.

hints: Find the pawn and its last rank. Is it one step from that rank?
A pawn moves straight ahead only onto an empty square, and captures one square diagonally forward only onto an enemy piece.
Check the square straight ahead and then each of the two diagonal squares in front of the pawn.
items.explain: Yes. The pawn stands one step from the last rank and d8 is empty.
